svg.title: High-performance HMI example – crankcase line
svg.text: 06 – High-performance HMI (ISA-101 style): Level 2 screen SCR2_MCH_L2 – crankcase machining (FMS cell)
Grey background, dark text, NO colour for normal states. Colour (here red-orange) appears only for an alarm, always with shape + number.
◀ PLANT | MCH L1 [MCH L2] MCH L3 ASM LOG | ALARMS (2) TRENDS REPORT
09:38:12 HMC02_A5111 Spindle vibration high 4.8 mm/s (HIGH 4.5) – unack
08:55:40 B_PAL pallet buffer low 1/8 – returned to normal, acknowledged
HMC-02 vibration, last 60 min (1-min average) – dashed: HIGH 4.5 / HIGH-HIGH 7.1 mm/s
Design rules visible here: grey normal band on each analog bar (normal operating range), black ticks = alarm limits, pointer = value; state as text + symbol (▶ running, ‖ stopped),
no green/red for running/stopped; one alarm → the only coloured items: banner symbol, card frame, pointer, value. Values from config/factory.json limits (HMC: 75 °C, 4.5 / 7.1 mm/s).
